question: Which is the first State where India's first organic fish cluster was launched by the Central Government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sikkim** is the first state in India where the **Central Government launched the first organic fish cluster.**
 
• The initiative is part of the Central Government's efforts to promote sustainable aquaculture practices and enhance the livelihoods of local fish farmers.
 
• The fish cluster project aligns with Sikkim's status as India's **first fully organic state**, emphasizing ecological sustainability and organic farming practices.
 
• This organic fish cluster aims to support fish farmers by providing them with the necessary resources, training, and infrastructure to adopt organic practices.
 
• The project also seeks to increase the production and distribution of organic fish products, contributing to both environmental conservation and the economic development of the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sikkim as India's Organic State:**

 
 
• Sikkim was declared as India's **first organic state** in **2016**, following a decade-long process of converting agricultural land into certified organic farmland.
 
• The state achieved this milestone under the **Organic Mission initiative**, which promotes sustainable farming practices.
 
• Sikkim's organic certification covers various agricultural products, including vegetables, fruits, and cereals.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Aquaculture Practices:**
 
 
• Organic aquaculture involves raising fish in an environment free from synthetic chemicals, antibiotics, and artificial growth enhancers.
 
• It emphasizes using natural feed, maintaining water quality, and adopting eco-friendly practices to ensure the health of aquatic ecosystems.
 
• Such practices help reduce environmental pollution and promote biodiversity in water bodies.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives for Fisheries:**
 
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)** was launched in **2020** to enhance fish production and create employment opportunities in the fisheries sector.
 
• The scheme focuses on promoting sustainable aquaculture practices, modernizing infrastructure, and ensuring the welfare of fish farmers.
 
• India aims to achieve a fish production target of **22 million metric tons** by **2024–25** under this initiative.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Organic Farming:**
 
 
• Organic farming minimizes the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides, reducing soil and water contamination.
 
• It promotes biodiversity, improves soil fertility, and contributes to sustainable agricultural practices.
 
• Organic products are in high demand globally due to their health benefits and environmental sustainability.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sikkim's Achievements in Organic Farming:**

 
 
• The state has won numerous accolades for its organic farming initiatives, including the **Future Policy Award 2018** by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).
 
• Sikkim's organic model serves as an inspiration for other states in India to adopt sustainable agricultural practices.
 
 
 
• **Role of Fisheries in India's Economy:**
 
 
• The fisheries sector contributes about **1.24%** to India's Gross Value Added (GVA) and provides livelihoods to millions of people.
 
• India is the second-largest producer of fish globally, with a focus on both capture and culture fisheries.
